# The NTRIP cases tools/csharp-reference/MpComms.cs runs through CommsNTRIP.Open, and
# crates/mp-transport/tests/csharp_goldens.rs through NtripTransport. A line starting `#` is a
# comment. `{port}` is the mock caster's port.
#
# request <v1|v2> <url>: the exact bytes of the request, the caster answering `ICY 200 OK`.
request v2 ntrip://127.0.0.1:{port}/MOUNT
request v1 ntrip://127.0.0.1:{port}/MOUNT
request v2 ntrip://user:pass@127.0.0.1:{port}/MOUNT
request v1 ntrip://user:pass@127.0.0.1:{port}/MOUNT
request v2 http://user:pass@127.0.0.1:{port}/MOUNT
request v2 ntrip://127.0.0.1:{port}
request v2 ntrip://127.0.0.1:{port}/
request v2 ntrip://me@example.com:pa55@127.0.0.1:{port}/RTK2GO
request v2 ntrip://user:p@ss@127.0.0.1:{port}/MOUNT
request v2 ntrip://user:p!s*s'(1)$&+,;=%@127.0.0.1:{port}/MOUNT
request v2 ntrip://user:pass@LocalHost:{port}/Mount Point
request v2 ntrip://127.0.0.1:{port}/a(b)*c'd!e?x=1&y=2#frag
request v2 ntrip://127.0.0.1:{port}/one/./two/../three
request v2 ntrip://127.0.0.1:{port}/café
request v2 ntrip://:secret@127.0.0.1:{port}/MOUNT
request v2 ntrip://mü:x@127.0.0.1:{port}/MOUNT
request v2 NTRIP://127.0.0.1:{port}/MOUNT
request v2 ntrip://justuser@127.0.0.1:{port}/MOUNT
request v2 ntrip://a@b:c@d@127.0.0.1:{port}/MOUNT
request v2 ntrip://127.0.0.1:99999/MOUNT
#
# response <status line>: what Open does with the caster's first line.
response ICY 200 OK
response HTTP/1.1 200 OK
response SOURCETABLE 200 OK
response HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
response ERROR - Bad Password
response HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
